turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Good choice. We use he/she/it + verb + -s for habits: She drinks coffee every day. Verbs ending in -ch or -sh take -es: he watches.

Try this one: He ___ (drink) tea in the morning. Write only the verb.

C1 (correct) strength 1: add -s/-es after he/she/it. Independent correct productions so far: 0.
